lane.irregularity: The supplied prompt references a single method paragraph that was not included. No authorized lane is inferred; WBG-D1 is a self-declared, preregistered research lane and its output reaches at most a separate selector, never an automatic slot.
lane.scope: Radiometric alteration / shallow magnetic edge lane for concealed, non-ridge-expressed faults. No previous prediction pixel, leaderboard inversion, catalogue-distance pruning as an objective, or registry-hole targeting enters the method. The overlap gates are acceptance tests, not optimization targets.

hypothesis: Concealed basin/interior faults without topographic ridge expression carry two physically independent signatures: (i) hydrothermal alteration halos with local potassium enrichment relative to thorium and compositional edge energy in the USGS GeoDAWN airborne radiometric grids; (ii) coincident shallow magnetic discontinuities (RTP gradient; TMI minus 150 m upward-continued TMI). Fusing these off-ridge signals with the shared 19-band potential-field stack in the fixed spatial cross-fitted HGB framework improves whole-component hide-and-recover recovery over the 19-band control, while yielding a spatially distinct sparse dot field.
mechanism: Robust-standardized Gaussian high-pass residuals and gradient-magnitude edges of K, Th/K and U/Th at 500 m-1 km scales isolate localized compositional change from broad lithologic gradients; a TMI-vs-upward-continuation residual isolates shallow magnetic sources; HistGradientBoosting combines the seven new channels with the nineteen cached bands under whole-component spatial LOQO cross-fitting.
non_fault_mimic: Playa/evaporite and Pleistocene Lake Lahontan paleo-lacustrine clays and potassium-bearing basin fill, sediment sorting/weathering, radiometric flight-line leveling, and cultural magnetic noise. Mitigated by requiring concord across independent channels rather than any single anomaly.

data_inputs.radiometric: data/external/geodawn_rad_u8.tif (K, Th, U, TC; uint8; nodata 0) sha256 c22420f75999030d7cc65c9e31e50d232ea6158423bca051613a18a8d7538582
data_inputs.official_source: USGS GeoDAWN airborne magnetic and radiometric surveys, sciencebase item 657e1d85d34e23d3533209f7, DOI 10.5066/P93LGLVQ; owner-derived resampled grids, organizer-origin not independently authenticated; live USGS re-verification unavailable from this sandbox network allowlist
data_inputs.forbidden_inputs: prior prediction rasters as features or labels, sample_submission values, SGMC/QFault external traces, vent/well/temperature point data, registry dot coordinates

new_channels: K_hp5: robust-z K Gaussian high-pass residual, sigma=5 px (500 m)
K_hp10: robust-z K Gaussian high-pass residual, sigma=10 px (1 km)
potassic_hp5: K_hp5 minus ThK_hp5 (relative K enrichment vs Th/K)
ThK_edge5: gradient magnitude of robust-z Th/K smoothed at sigma=5
K_edge5: gradient magnitude of robust-z K smoothed at sigma=5
UTh_edge5: gradient magnitude of robust-z U/Th smoothed at sigma=5
tmi_shallow: robust-z TMI (band 14) minus robust-z TMI_up150

deterministic_composite_exp1.formula: S = 0.5*potassic_hp5 + 0.3*K_hp10 + 0.4*tanh(rtp_edge3/2) + 0.3*tanh(ThK_edge5/2); rtp_edge3 = gradient magnitude of robust-z RTP (band 2) smoothed at sigma=3
deterministic_composite_exp1.emission: skimage peak_local_max min_distance=3 px, num_peaks=37654, restricted to footprint and excluding catalogue pixels; binary dots of value 1.0
deterministic_composite_exp1.random_baseline: fixed-seed 37654 uniform-random dots over the same allowed mask

bootstrap.method: shared paired physical 20 km block percentile

same_instrument_prior_control.source_run_card: registry/run_card.json (WBG-C1 control_19band_hgb); rerun identically inside EXP-2 rather than trusted across sessions

leakage_canary: Each of the 26 input channels tested alone per fold with audit.single_feature_canary; orientation-invariant AUC > 0.90 stops the experiment. Missingness AUC reported for the radiometric channels.
efficacy_gate: EXP-2 candidate paired 95% CI lower bound > 0 versus the simultaneously refitted 19-band control on the identical folds, with candidate pooled DTI no worse than the prior same-instrument control (0.0141455).

registry_gate.support_definition: all finite p > 0; no density exemption
registry_gate.scope: registry/focus_inventory.json (377 files, 360 unique hashes, nine frozen owner snapshots) plus three project-local prior artifacts in docs/downloads (tip1, wbg-h1, wbg-c1). Literal and dot-field like-for-like readings both reported; continuous-surface priors cannot be dot-compared and are never silently filtered from the Spearman test.
registry_gate.on_stop: retain evidence, verdict negative, no promotion claims

experiments.description: deterministic radiometric composite NMS dots and random baseline on v2 holdout; no fitting
19-band control vs 19+7 channel HGB spatial LOQO, continuous OOF surfaces, per-channel canaries, paired pooled DTI
full-footprint synthesis of the better arm, fixed-budget NMS dots, full registry uniqueness, portal validation, TIF/ZIP/run card

promotion.rule: promote-to-selector only if format gates, both uniqueness gates and the efficacy gate all pass; weekly-slot upload remains a separate manual action because no authenticated uploader exists

score_policy: New measurements are HOLDOUT-DTI with evaluator version, withheld-positive count and 95% CI. User-supplied historical numbers remain USER-REPORTED, never ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED. No leaderboard projection is presented as a score.
